newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Wednesday estimate 95,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Wednesday estimate 95,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Wednesday were 95,000 head, compared with 99,000 a week ago and 109,000 a year ago.

Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts $0.50-$1.00 higher than midsession Tuesday. Trade was slow for good demand and light offerings. Weather conditions slowing movement in northwest part of area.

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct. carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
